`class SetSignal<E>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Set<E>>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.iterable` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SetSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/iterable/SetSignal.java)

Signal of a set that keeps the insertion order, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies its followers.

## Description

It works like [`ListSignal`](/reference/signals/listsignal/): the value is a read-only copy, each method writes a changed copy, and the read methods record the read.
The elements keep the order in which they were added.

### SetSignal
